problem_description: Lack of formal, bidirectionally traceable physical mapping in KnowledgeOS for the 12 data lineage links (LIN-001 through LIN-012) connecting source RAW files to Copilot queries.
root_cause: Data lineage was documented in governance registries but not physically materialised as a structured, indexable, and Obsidian-compatible domain under knowledge/lineage/.
strategy: Created physical master lineage index (knowledge/lineage/INDEX.md), 12 stage specifications (stages/LIN-001.md to LIN-012.md), and 10 question lineage maps (questions/QF-001.md to QF-010.md) under knowledge/lineage/ linking every lineage link to its corresponding contract (CTR-001 to CTR-011), evidence, capability, and financial question without modifying DuckDB or engine code.
